title: AssertSameAs
description: Asserts that two entities are the same. Emitted ONLY for an approved equivalence: a match from a rule permitted to merge automatically, or a review candidate a human approved. An unreviewed proposal is a :SAME_AS_CANDIDATE in Neo4j and emits nothing. The Virtuoso sink writes <a> owl:sameAs <b> in the graph for the entity type and lets the OWL2-RL reasoner close the equivalence class; the Neo4j sink writes a SAME_AS edge. Withdraw an assertion with RetractSameAs.

rule.description: Consolidator rule that produced this match.
